title: Mobile Test Engineer - SDET I
description:
**Mobile Test Engineer**

**ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Associate Analyst**

**About the Role**

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics.

This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.

This role owns quality for the fan-facing mobile experience across Android and iOS. You are the last line of defense before a release reaches fans, and the first person to know when something is not right.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Test Coverage**

* Design, write, and execute manual and automated test cases for new and existing Mobile App features

* Build and maintain automated UI test suites for Android using frameworks such as Espresso or Appium

* Validate API responses and data integrity across content, identity, personalization, and notification features

**Find and Drive Out Defects**

* Log, triage, and track defects through resolution, working with Engineering to reproduce and verify fixes

* Perform regression, exploratory, and smoke testing ahead of App Store and Play Store releases

* Monitor crash reports, analytics, and post-release quality metrics to catch emerging issues early

**Ship as One Team**

* Join sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness reviews to define coverage and acceptance criteria

* Work day to day with Android and iOS Engineering, Product, and Design to clarify expected behavior

* Document test plans, results, and known issues so the team can act on them quickly

**Raise the Bar**

* Improve testing practices, tooling, and automation coverage over time rather than repeating manual effort

**Reporting Relationships**

Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with Android and iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Design, and partners with Product Management on release readiness.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

* 1+ years of experience in manual or automated testing of mobile applications on Android or iOS

* Experience writing and executing test cases and test plans

* Familiarity with at least one mobile test automation framework, such as Espresso, Appium, or XCUITest

* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

**Preferred**

* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman

* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail

* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile app testing

* Experience testing consumer-facing mobile apps in sports, media, or entertainment

**Core Competencies**

* Detail-oriented and methodical about reproducing and isolating defects

* Writes issues engineers can act on immediately

* Comfortable working across Android and iOS in a fast-moving environment

* Collaborative with engineering, product, and design

* Curious about mobile platforms and motivated to improve how testing gets done

**Why This Role Matters**

A single bad release costs fan trust that takes months to earn back. This role protects that, and it is a direct path into deeper mobile engineering and automation work on a product people use every week.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

We are looking for a skilled **Mobile Application Test Engineer** with strong experience in Android and iOS testing, mobile test automation, API validation, and network troubleshooting. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise with **Charles Proxy, device logs, and Appium**, along with exposure to AI-powered testing, LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI agents.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Perform functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and compatibility testing of Android and iOS applications.
* Test on real devices, simulators, and emulators across different OS versions and configurations.
* Analyze HTTP/HTTPS traffic using Charles Proxy to troubleshoot API requests, responses, and network-related issues.
* Debug application crashes and failures using Android Logcat and iOS device logs.
* Perform API testing using Postman and validate mobile-to-backend integrations.
* Design test scenarios, test cases, test data, and reusable automation utilities.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot mobile automation frameworks.
* Perform root cause analysis and document defects with supporting logs, screenshots, and recordings.
* Leverage AI tools for test case generation, test automation, log analysis, and defect investigation.
* Validate AI-enabled features for response accuracy, relevance, consistency, and reliability.
* Collaborate with developers, product teams, and QA engineers to ensure release quality.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

* Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, test design techniques, defect management, and risk-based testing.
* Hands-on experience with Android and iOS application testing on real devices and simulators/emulators.
* Strong working knowledge of **Charles Proxy**, HTTPS traffic inspection, and API troubleshooting.
* Experience analyzing Android Logcat and iOS application/device logs.
* Good understanding of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, authentication, and client-server architecture.
* Programming knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Understanding of mobile application lifecycle, permissions, deep links, push notifications, and local storage.
* Experience with Postman, Jira, Git, and Agile methodologies.

**Test Automation & Frameworks**
--------------------------------

* Hands-on experience with **Appium or equivalent mobile automation frameworks**.
* Understanding of Page Object Model/Screen Object Model and reusable framework components.
* Experience with test runners, test data management, reporting, synchronization, and flaky test troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with TestNG/JUnit, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD integration using Jenkins or similar tools.
* Ability to debug, enhance, and maintain scalable automation frameworks.

**AI, LLM, RAG & AI Agents**
----------------------------

* Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted testing.
* Exposure to AI-driven test case generation, test script assistance, and automated defect analysis.
* Knowledge of LLM evaluation, including response accuracy, relevance, consistency, and hallucination detection.
* Understanding of RAG pipelines and testing retrieval accuracy, source grounding, and response quality.
* Familiarity with AI agents, tool calling, API integrations, error handling, and task completion validation.
* Awareness of responsible AI practices, data privacy, and prompt injection risks.

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Experience with BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or cloud-based mobile testing platforms.
* Exposure to LangChain, LlamaIndex, LLM APIs, or vector databases.
* Familiarity with AI evaluation tools such as RAGAS or DeepEval.
* Knowledge of SQL, mobile performance testing, application security, and CI/CD pipelines.

**Job Description**
 ABOUT AMGEN
   

  

 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role we are seeking a skilled and proactive macOS/JAMF Engineer with hands\-on experience managing mobile and Apple devices using JAMF and other Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions. This role is responsible for configuring, securing, deploying, and supporting enterprise macOS systems to ensure seamless and secure device operation across the organization. The ideal candidate will also have a solid background in automation with JAMF API, scripting and app integration to improve mobile infrastructure performance and streamline deployment processes
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Administer and manage Apple devices using JAMF Pro and other MDM platforms.
* Design and implement mobile device configurations, policies, and profiles to support business needs.
* Develop automated workflows for device provisioning, software deployment, patching, and compliance checks.
* Integrate third\-party and internal applications with MDM tools for seamless app delivery and management.
* Collaborate with developers and IT teams to build or support custom scripts, APIs, and internal apps tailored for the mobile environment.
* Monitor and support mobile infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
* Ensure mobile devices align with corporate security and usage policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture, SOPs, and deployment guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to mobile device deployments, applications, and integration workflows.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is with these qualifications.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**
* Master's degree / bachelor’s degree and 5 to 9 years in a MacOS Engineer or Systems Administrator role


**Functional Skills:**
* Deep expertise with JAMF Pro and Apple ecosystem (macOS, iOS).
* Solid understanding of MDM tools (e.g., Intune).
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python).
* Experience building or supporting automation and app integration pipelines.
* Understanding of API integrations and mobile application deployment.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced environment with minimal direction.
* JAMF 200, 300, or higher certification.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager, DEP, and VPP.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools or platforms related to mobile app deployment.
* Background in enterprise macOS within regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks in mobile environments.


**Professional Certifications:**
* Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) for Teams (preferred)


**Soft Skills:**
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Team\-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global and virtual teams.

description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.**


We are looking for a **Senior Engineer** with strong iOS development experience to design, develop, and maintain high\-quality iOS SDK solutions that support our hearing healthcare products.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Design, develop, test, and maintain iOS SDK modules using Swift and modern iOS frameworks.
* Build clean, reusable, and maintainable APIs and software components.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across SDK, app integration, and device communication layers.
* Develop and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure software quality.
* Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architecture reviews.
* Mentor engineers through knowledge sharing, reviews, and technical guidance.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, Test Engineers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver solutions.

**What you bring**
------------------

### **Experience**

* 4–6 years of software development experience with a strong focus on iOS development.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Experience delivering production\-grade iOS applications or SDKs.

### **Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Swift and modern iOS development.
* Good understanding of iOS architecture, concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of design patterns, SOLID principles, testing, and clean architecture.
* Experience with CI/CD and mobile release processes.
* Exposure to Bluetooth (BLE/Core Bluetooth) is a plus.

### **Personal Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ownership mindset and attention to quality.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to mentor and support team members.

**Who we are**
--------------


At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.


Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.


With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

**Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.**


WSA is an equal\-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.
